info.name: SEC EDGAR & XBRL Company Facts Submissions API

params.name: cik
params.description: 10-digit Central Index Key (CIK) with leading zeros. Example: 0000320193 for Apple Inc.

items.docs: Returns all filing metadata for a company identified by CIK (Central Index Key). Includes recent filings inline and older filings referenced in separate data files. Contains company metadata, SIC code, fiscal year end, and filing history.
